SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID='KOLN') AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND RQDT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND RQDT.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND 0 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG <> 'Y') ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT NVL(A.STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, NVL(A.QUOTATION_NO ,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(A.QUOTATION_SEQ ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(A.REVISION , 0) AS REVISION_NO, NVL(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.DESCRIPTION ,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION ,' ') AS SPECFICATION, NVL(A.UNIT_MEASURE ,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , 0 ) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(A.ATOB_REMARK ,' ') AS SEND_REMARK FROM KEPRQDT A INNER JOIN KEPQTDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY C ON (1 = 1 AND C.COM_CODE = B.AGENT ) WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND A.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Z' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'
